The envelope features red graphical designs, including a sunburst pattern on the nose and stylized text/logos along the side. A dark gondola structure is suspended beneath the hull, connected by rigging. Ground support equipment and vehicles are visible in the foreground and background.

The connection points between the gondola and the hull, as well as the ground vehicles, are indistinct and muddy, lacking mechanical clarity.
